issues.article_text: Jack Dorsey cortou 4.000 na Block dizendo que a decisão 'não foi motivada por dificuldade financeira, mas pela crescente capacidade das ferramentas de IA.'
issues.detail: Block's 4,000 layoffs were announced on February 26, 2026 — two weeks before this edition's window. The article presents this as a specific event within a layoffs roundup pegged to a fresh NetworkWorld tally (March 11), but the individual event is stale.

issues.event: Oracle potential 20,000-30,000 job cuts per TD Cowen report
issues.article_text: A Oracle pode eliminar até 30.000 posições para liberar $6-7 bilhões de fluxo de caixa e investir em infraestrutura de IA
issues.detail: The TD Cowen report projecting Oracle layoffs of 20,000-30,000 was published in late January 2026. The article mixes this stale projection with Oracle's fresh Q3 earnings (March 10), making it appear as a current development.
